description: Shared RTA display parity vectors (epic #1705). Feed each case's frames, in order, into the display model with the case's ballistics and target; after each frame the model must match that frame's expected entry to toleranceDb. The first frame of a case is adopted as-is. targetOffsetsDb are display offsets on the case's band grid (already bandwidth-corrected, see docs/rta-target-convention.md); null means no target (relative to the measured mean).
